name: Dr. Sarah Mitchell
bio: Dr. Mitchell is a board-certified general physician with over 12 years of experience in primary care, preventive medicine, and chronic disease management.

name: Dr. James Okafor
bio: Dr. Okafor is a renowned cardiologist specializing in heart failure, arrhythmia management, and preventive cardiology with 18 years of clinical excellence.

name: Dr. Priya Sharma
bio: Dr. Sharma is a compassionate pediatrician dedicated to child health and development, immunizations, and managing childhood illnesses with a gentle approach.

name: Dr. Carlos Rivera
bio: Dr. Rivera is a dermatology expert with a focus on skin cancer detection, acne treatment, eczema management, and cosmetic dermatology procedures at home.

name: Dr. Emily Chen
bio: Dr. Chen is a neurologist specializing in migraines, epilepsy, stroke rehabilitation, and neurodegenerative diseases. She is known for her thorough and empathetic approach.

name: Dr. Ahmed Al-Farsi
bio: Dr. Al-Farsi is a veteran orthopedic specialist with 20 years in joint pain, sports injuries, spinal conditions, and post-operative home rehabilitation care.

name: Dr. Lena Müller
bio: Dr. Müller is a highly experienced gynecologist offering women's health consultations, prenatal guidance, menstrual health, and hormonal care at home.

name: Dr. Samuel Osei
bio: Dr. Osei is an enthusiastic general practitioner focused on holistic patient care, lifestyle medicine, and managing chronic conditions like diabetes and hypertension.

name: Dr. Yuki Tanaka
bio: Dr. Tanaka is a child health specialist known for her nurturing bedside manner, expertise in developmental pediatrics, and multilingual patient communication.

name: Dr. Marcus Webb
bio: Dr. Webb is a leading cardiologist with over two decades of experience in interventional cardiology, cardiac imaging, and advanced heart failure management.
